other_failure_modes.name: Unapplied Feature Scaling
other_failure_modes.description: The agent initializes and fits a StandardScaler on the training features but fails to ever apply the transformation, passing unscaled features (including large interaction products) directly into the neural network.

summary: The agent develops a strong pipeline featuring domain-specific feature engineering, cross-validation, and an ensemble of gradient boosting and deep learning models. However, it fails to evaluate the models with metrics appropriate for imbalanced data (relying solely on accuracy), uses hardcoded ensemble weights without any optimization, and contains a bug where the fitted feature scaler is never actually applied to the data.
